summary: Practise risk-based safety audits, control verification, and findings reporting. Explore the five-day course and plan your team’s training.
lede: Safety auditing helps safety auditors, HSE managers, and operational assurance professionals evaluate whether workplace controls work in practice. Training covers audit planning and risk-based evidence sampling, field verification through records, interviews, and observations, and assessing findings by risk. Participants also practise reviewing corrective actions and using digital audit registers and Excel-based analysis to track issues and support improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, conduct, oversee, or act on workplace health and safety audits across operational environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace health and safety practices, safety inspections, or management-system documentation is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet access if you want to complete the Excel-based audit register exercises; advanced analytics and AI applications receive conceptual coverage only.
